svg.title: Lane map for 64 FP32 numerator values and two FP32 denominators
svg.desc: A 16 by 32 output tile showing the four-lane channel ownership of row 17, the 64-register D layout, and the lane-17 denominator owner.
svg.text: Warp ownership: four M16 query tiles, 64 FP32 numerator values per lane
Warp 0 of the q17 CTA is shown. Row 1 of M16 tile 1 is global query 17. Four lanes divide its 32 output channels.
Lane 4 owns c0/c1, c8/c9, c16/c17, c24/c25 for row 1
and the same eight channels for row 9 (D2/D3).
orange: r_Output[1][1][1] is query 17, output channel 9 (global channel 233)
r_Denominator[0]: queries 0..31 of the warp (query 17 lives here)
each lane owns one low and one high query sum
final broadcast reads lane 17 low for query 17
Instruction roles differ inside one warp
QK: MmaWindowFragment -> Half C/D in both precisions
FP8 P operand is E4M3(E); D sums the original Half E
The QK fragment words stay Half. Widening the PV accumulator does not widen the scores, the surrogate or the stored P operand.
Lane 4 is the output owner for c9; lane 17 is the denominator owner for q17. They are different lanes on purpose:
the PV fragment is distributed by output column, while the row reduction is transposed to one query per lane.
Per lane: 4 query tiles x 4 N8 groups x 4 D registers = 64 FP32 numerator values, plus 2 FP32 denominators.
